_meta.title: Merge manifest — the v20 + donor merge oracle, as data
_meta.author: MiniMax (S-1900–1999)
_meta.status: PROPOSED — the Architect owns the values; advisors propose. Nothing here is a build.
_meta.why: The oracle lived in a relayed chat paste, three bulletins and two lanes' tools. A pin without a machine-readable home is a pin that gets re-derived under pressure — four pins were voided in this council for exactly that. This file is that home, and the lint reads it instead of hardcoding pins.
_meta.authority: Product files remain read-only to every advisor (R1/R3). This manifest is a proposal artifact inside _agents/minimax/.
_meta.revision: rev 2 — 20 Oct 2026: surfaces block added; branch C measured (the minimal deviation is ONE function, not a pair); the dynamic gate now enumerates the season entry paths.

extraction_rules.R1_function_body: First <script> block, split on '\n'. A body runs from its column-0 'function NAME(' line through the LAST line whose trim()==='}' before the NEXT column-0 'function' line; join with '\n'; sha256 WITHOUT a trailing newline; first 12 hex. (DS funcdiff-full.js; Pickle math-baseline.json _extraction_rule.)
extraction_rules.R2_constant: sha256 of the FIRST '^const NAME' declaration line, trailing newline stripped, whitespace NOT normalised; first 12 hex.
extraction_rules.R3_top_level_names: Declared symbols = column-0 'function NAME(', 'const|let|var NAME', 'class NAME'. Inner block declarations are not global symbols.

known_artefacts.checkRewards: The canonical rule over-reads the adjacent column-0 #glue phone IIFE, so it lists as differing. Its true body is identical in both parents. Excluded from the 17 and from the pin set (Pickle M-50 addendum).
known_artefacts.void_pin: The checkRewards pin 0a000ce52783 reproduces under NO stated rule and is withdrawn; the finding is proven by diff, not by hash.
known_artefacts.trailing_newline: A pin taken over 'awk | shasum' (which appends a newline) differs from a full-body pin. State the rule or the pin is void.

static.note: The two parents fail the static lint by design: they are the pre-merge inputs, not candidates. fixA fails only on the half-taken surface; fixB and fixC pass.

acceptance.browser: a Chromium-family browser with --remote-debugging-port=9222; Brave on macOS: '/Applications/Brave Browser.app/Contents/MacOS/Brave Browser' --headless=new --remote-debugging-port=9222 --user-data-dir=/tmp/minimax-profile about:blank
acceptance.stop_condition: If the two build sha256 values do not reproduce, or the gate does not exit 0, STOP and report. Do not edit the candidate to make it pass — a patched-to-green candidate destroys the evidence that the merge is a merge (Pickle M-45).

corrections.was: the donor's draft-results → season entry is a unit, so renderDraftResults AND finishDraft2 must be taken together from one build (11 donor / 4 v20 / 2 synthesize).
corrections.now: the coupling is in renderDraftResults alone. With v20's renderDraftResults the donor's finishDraft2 still works (branch C, 12 donor / 3 v20 / 2 synthesize): the results panel carries its own Season tab (resultsSeasonBtn) and the season is reachable through it.
corrections.why: the dynamic gate used to try only ctaPlaySeasonBtn/startSeasonBtn; it now enumerates the entry paths (ctaPlaySeasonBtn → resultsSeasonTab → tabSeasonBtn → already-rendered), which is what exposed branch C.

surfaces_note: The surfaces block is the coupling the 17-function list cannot express: a surface's variant implies the DOM scaffolding and helper symbols it needs. `surface:<name>/<variant>` checks are FAILs when a candidate carries a variant without its scaffolding — that is what catches a half-taken surface (M-59/M-60). Human-readable twin: _agents/minimax/SURFACES.md.
